key_insight: CIDERS turns cloud-edge LLM collaboration into a personalized bilevel optimization problem, balancing global consensus with edge-specific adaptation through consensus-variate correction.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical solver for deploying LLMs in cloud-edge settings where shared knowledge must be continuously personalized for domain-constrained edge devices.
method: Decompose the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger for efficient cloud-to-edge knowledge transfer.
Use bilevel optimization: cloud-side lower level for knowledge transfer, edge-side upper level for personalization.
Inject global trajectories into each local update via consensus-variate correction to align personalization with consensus.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong gains over baselines on compressed edge tasks, including 3.1x improvement in mathematical reasoning, 1.7x in code generation, and 10% relative gain on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds optimization complexity and may be sensitive to the stability/communication cost of coordination between cloud and edge during continual personalization.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
